scripts.build: node scripts/source-provenance.mjs && node scripts/build-canvas-kit.mjs && node scripts/sync-sandbox-csp.mjs && node scripts/check-css-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && vite build && node scripts/check-no-mock-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:mock: node scripts/source-provenance.mjs && node scripts/build-canvas-kit.mjs && node scripts/sync-sandbox-csp.mjs && node scripts/check-css-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && vite build --mode mock
scripts.gate: node scripts/gate-run.mjs 'node scripts/gate-record.mjs --start && npm run gate:frontend && npm run gate:rust && node scripts/gate-record.mjs'
scripts.gate:frontend: node scripts/check-installed-lock.mjs && export TZ=America/New_York && npm run plan:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:scripts && npm run build && npm run bundle:budget
scripts.gate:rust: node scripts/check-cargo-target.mjs && export TZ=America/New_York && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --lib --tests -- -D warnings && cargo test --lib
scripts.smoke:critical: PW_PORT=${PW_PORT:-1431} playwright test --project=chromium-desktop --workers=1 tests/smoke/app-smoke.spec.ts tests/smoke/layout.spec.ts tests/smoke/top-bar-visible.spec.ts tests/smoke/rail-tree.spec.ts tests/smoke/quick-chats.spec.ts tests/smoke/canvas-inline.spec.ts tests/smoke/canvas-focus.spec.ts tests/smoke/canvas-kit-ask.spec.ts tests/smoke/preview-pane.spec.ts tests/smoke/next-level-conversation.spec.ts tests/smoke/keyboard-shortcuts.spec.ts tests/smoke/launch-ipc.spec.ts tests/smoke/transition-click.spec.ts
scripts.tauri:build: npm run tauri:bundle && npm run tauri:install
